30-Sep: Checked all pump stations. Plant is running well.
01-Oct: No mechanical issues detected at the plant and pump stations

05-Oct: Both blending tank mixers running. Blowers are running. Smell is good. Aeration is good. No issues at the pump stations detected. Added 5
chlorine tabs at ying yang dam

08-Oct: Plant is running well. All pump stations are low. Trench at Waldorf 50% done
09-Oct: Checked all pump stations. Still busy digging the new line at Waldorf school
12-Oct: Waldorf school trench done - will commence laying the pipe tomorrow. Plant is running well. All pump stations levels were low
13-Oct: Aeration good. Smell is good. All pump stations low
14-Oct: Plant is running well. No issues detected
16-Oct: Installing new line at Waldorf school today. All pump stations are low
19-Oct: All pump stations are low. Blowers were running. Aeration and smell is good
20-Oct: Smell is good. Aeration is good. All pump stations are low.
21-Oct: Northbank pump had an issue today - inspected electric components, cleaned pump impeller and found pump is faulty and took out for repairs. A
spare pump was installed as a temporary measure. Bioreactor was running well and all other pump stations in good condition even Waldorf school is low
after installing the new pipe line
22-Oct: Grass was cut today. Northbank pump still operating well after yesterday's issues- pump pushing water at just over 6L/s
23-0Oct: Checked all pump stations. Plant is running well.
26-Oct: Plant is running well. All pump stations are low. Aeration is good and smell is good
28-Oct: Took 7 samples. Added 5 chlorine tabs. Added 3 bags of lime
29-Oct: Topped up.anoxic mixer one oil. Plant is running well..no mechanical issues detected
